loader_messages: ☕ One sip of tea and I’m done 😄
🧪 Trying a few options and choosing the best one.
locale.better_audio_please: It’s better if we practice with real conversation 🎙️ Next time, please send a voice message.
locale.translation_fallback_missing: I don’t have a translation for this message yet.
locale.hints_intro: Here are a few options you can say next:
locale.hints_empty: I don’t have suggestions for this message yet. Try with the next reply.
locale.hi_message_text:
Hi! Let’s do a 30-second speaking test 👋
Send one short voice or text message (1–2 sentences), and I’ll reply with:
✅ transcript
✅ corrections + short explanation
✅ what to say next

I set your default level to B1.
Want to change it? Tap the button below 👇
locale.choose_voice_mode_text: How would you like to receive my replies: voice or text? 🎧💬
locale.msg_too_long: That’s a bit long 🙂 Try 1–2 sentences for better quality corrections.
locale.msg_to_bot: 🤖→🤖 Hey colleague! If you’re a bot, blink twice 😄 Please send me one spoken sentence.
locale.msg_error_command: Oops, I don’t know that command yet 🙈
locale.msg_next_step: Now send me a short voice message (1–2 sentences) 🎙️ I’ll correct mistakes and explain clearly 🙂
locale.stats_footer: Details and subscription management are available in the mini-app below.
locale.msg_limit_reached: I’d love to keep practicing with you, but you’ve already reached the free plan lifetime limit 😔\nTo continue, open the subscription in the mini-app with the button below ✨\n⬇️⬇️⬇️
locale.msg_tts_limit_reached: You’ve reached the weekly limit for my voice replies 😔 Check /stats.
locale.msg_too_short: I couldn’t hear anything 😭 Please try a slightly longer voice message.
locale.msg_feedback_prompt: Thanks! Please send your feedback as text or a voice message 🎙️
locale.msg_feedback_needs_text_or_voice: Please send feedback as text or voice message 🎙️
locale.onboarding_start_practice_text: Great start ✨ Want to choose a topic, or continue freely? You can send a voice or text message anytime.
locale.onboarding_example_text: Example 1 (commute): ❌ Even on Monday, I go to my work with half-closed eyes. ✅ Even on Monday, I go to work with half-closed eyes. 🧠 Rule: We say go to work without "my". Example 2 (remote work): ❌ On Fridays, I work in home in pajamas during meetings. ✅ On Fridays, I work from home in pajamas during meetings. 🧠 Rule: For remote work, we say work from home, not "in home". Now it's your turn 🙂 Send 1–2 short sentences.
locale.onboarding_voice_cta_text: Great. Send a short voice message (1–2 sentences) 🎙️
locale.onboarding_text_cta_text: Great. Send a short text message (1–2 sentences) ✍️
locale.onboarding_complete_change_hint: You can change your level anytime with /level.
locale.onboarding_complete_daily_hint: Daily consistency matters most: even 10 minutes every day builds fluency.
locale.onboarding_showcase_no_mistakes_text:
Very good, no mistakes here 👏
If you want to see how I fix mistakes, send something intentionally wrong.
For example:
❌ Yesterday I go to work by bus.
locale.onboarding_complete_full_text:
Awesome progress — your profile is ready 🚀

A few quick notes:
• Use the buttons below the chat to change level and voice anytime.
• XP grows with practice, and your streak gives you an extra boost.
• In APP, you can open more settings, send feedback, and manage other options.

Send your next message to keep the streak alive 🔥

Congratulations! Onboarding is finished.
locale.xp_streak_bonus_pending: Streak multiplier is not applied to awards yet.
